first_divergence.where: AFTER the scan, in delivery/presentation — not in retrieval
first_divergence.mechanism: Two readers of the same dataset disagree inside ONE turn. The planner's named-file scan matched both items; the pending-file direct reader produced a miss, and the PENDING result is the one rendered and pinned. The stored pending file objective is reconstructed from history ('[pending-file-task] legacy recovery'), and that history-tainted context is what the direct read runs with.
components: integrations/chat_orchestrator.py (pending_file_result takes rendering precedence over the turn's own scan)

second_defect_found_and_fixed.what: _probe_cached cached a MISS for the full positive TTL (300s).
second_defect_found_and_fixed.impact: One transient read failure published 'no matching row' for up to five minutes across turns — a false absence claim built by a cache, for rows that were present.
second_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Negative results are no longer cached (ATOM_SHEET_PROBE_NEGATIVE_TTL_SECONDS, default 0). Hits keep the full TTL. The cost is a re-read per miss, bounded by the turn budget, and it is paid deliberately.
